reason: The README describes a DSH integration that registers Claude Code as an alternate agent engine, routes sessions to it, streams execution trajectories, persists sessions, and bridges tool permissions and user prompts.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 接入 DSH 作为可选智能体引擎，并实时展示执行轨迹、上下文用量及工具交互。
summaries.en: Integrates Claude Code into DSH as an optional agent engine with live execution traces, context usage, and tool interactions.

capabilities: Registers a Claude Code engine for DSH session routing
Invokes the Claude Code executable or SDK for agent turns
Streams assistant, thinking, tool-call, and tool-result events into DSH
Persists Claude session identifiers for conversation continuation
Bridges workspace permissions and user questions to DSH approval and selection interfaces
Reports token usage and context-window information
Can trace Claude Code subagents as read-only DSH child sessions
